title: Page 4
content_zh:
她独自接下店里所有的事，尽量想办法赚钱养活自己，还要每个月凑出钱来还给债主。
说真的，很累。她一直不敢想太多，一直让自己尽量做好每件事情，现在一放松下来，那疲劳感瞬间就把她淹没。
热水泡得她有些晕乎乎的，她半张着眼，看到一片叶子落到了水面上，她觉得有趣，伸手想去捞，却不知道是泡晕了还是脚滑了，她一起身伸手，不只没捞到叶子，还失去平衡——
“啊——”她尖叫一声，狼狈的扑倒在水里，热烫的池水灌进口鼻，呛得她无法呼吸。
她挣扎着离开水面，膝盖传来阵阵剧痛。
她正想低头看一下膝上的伤，突然间砰的一声，她听到门被撞开的声音，然后下一秒，一个高大的身影已经出现在她眼前。
“怎么了？”他一脸担心。
乔若曦头发湿漉漉的，满脸温泉水跟泪水，膝盖又痛得要命，可是看到褚天阔，她嘴巴张得大大的，一句话也说不出来，连疼痛也忘了，只能双手抱胸——放声尖叫。
第2章(1)
裹在浴衣跟一大堆毛巾里的女人眼睛肿肿的，小小的鼻头也红红的，看起来分外可怜，像一只被淋湿的小猫一样，微微发着抖的身子让人想要把她抱进怀里。
褚天阔靠近她，却见她剧烈的颤抖了一下，看着他的那双大眼里写了警戒以及些许的控诉跟畏惧，让他不禁沉下脸。
“哪里受伤了？让我看。”
乔若曦死命的摇头。
还看？她全身上下都被他看光了！呜……好丢脸。
“让我看。”他的声音压低了，沉下的面容有着不容拒绝的威严。
她咬着下唇，最终还是怯怯的
他的脸色更难看了几分，粗厚的大掌抓住她的双腿，她又羞又怕的想要抽回，可是那双巨箝般的手让她无法移动半分。
“别动！”
她也动不了啊！
一旁有旅馆老板娘拿来的医药箱，他从中拿出碘酒跟棉花棒，“会有点痛。”他的声音放柔了些。

他不是没看过各种伤口的人，事实上，早些年，他每天过的还是那种逞凶斗狠的日子，只是那样丑陋的伤口不应该出现在这白皙柔软的无瑕肌肤上。
那伤口看起来就是碍眼，就是让他不舒服，一种近似疼痛的感觉在胸口隐隐泛开。
他专注在处理她的伤口，那双大手虽然看来粗鲁但却意外的温柔，而且他也不像她担心的那样会对她毛手毛脚，虽然他瞪着她伤口的样子仍然凶得让她心头怦怦直跳。
“谢谢……”
他抬头瞪她，那瞪视里有恼怒，更有隐约的心疼。
“呃……对不起……”其实她也不知道为什么要说对不起，可是看到他的表情，她觉得自己似乎应该这么说。
“以后小心点。”他咬牙。他不想再看她受伤，不能有人伤害她，就算她自己也不行。
乔若曦有种奇怪的感觉，好像伤的不是她，反而像是她打坏了他的东西，她下意识地缩了缩肩。
虽然知道自己那迷糊又不灵活的手脚，要不跌跌撞撞真是不太可能，可是这时候她也只好乖乖的说：“是。”
他皱了皱眉，似乎在决定要不要“原谅”她，她的一颗心吊在半空许久，才见他叹了口气。
温热的大掌抚上她的脸庞时她还呆呆的，不知道该如何反应，他给她的感觉跟温柔两个字扯不上关系，可是今天晚上他却一次又一次的令她惊讶不已。
就在她迷惑的时候，门外传来的敲门声把室内那暧昧的气氛给打破。
“对不起。”老板娘拉开了纸门，“小姐的伤还好吧？”
“嗯。”褚天阔代她回答了。
“是吗？那我就放心了。真的很抱歉，是我们的设施造成小姐受伤，小店一定负起赔偿责任。”
“不、不！不是啦！是我自己太不小心。”乔若曦连忙澄清。
“小姐真是客气，不过让我们表示一点歉意吧！晚餐就让本店招待好吗？两位这么一折腾应该也饿了，请问现在方便上菜了吗？”
说到晚餐，乔若曦的肚子竟然不争气的在这时候发出咕噜声。
一整天的担心害怕让她根本没吃多少东西，可是也不能在这个时候……
她的脸轰地一声红透了，老板娘低头掩住笑意，褚天阔没说什么，她却有种想死的感觉。

“晚餐马上给您送上来。”老板娘匆匆下去准备了。
没过多久，当热腾腾的帝王蟹火锅送上来时，乔若曦开心的早就忘了刚刚的丢脸。
“尝尝。”
依照老板娘的指示，她把蟹脚肉放进嘴里，鲜甜的滋味立刻散开，令人感动得几乎落下泪来。
“好……呜……好好吃！”
乔若曦是个喜爱美食的人，否则也没有办法当个好厨师。只是因为开店、再加上为了要省钱的关系，她已经好几年不曾外出用餐了，因此她此刻感到分外的幸福，幸福到几乎忘了身处的状况。
直到她的碗里多了一块烫好的蟹腿，她蓦然抬头，发现老板娘已经离去，把食物放进她碗里的只可能是一个人。
“啊，你吃就好了。”她想把蟹腿夹回他的碗里，却被他抓住手。
“给你。”
他喜欢看她吃东西的样子，喜欢她那闭着眼睛享受的模样。
不过对他而言，最好吃的食物是她做的，她的料理虽然不如大餐厅的华丽精致，却给人一种温暖的感觉。
她的咖啡屋装潢虽然有点小孩子气，但他在朋友推荐下去了一次之后就爱上那个滋味。
久而久之，他注意到了那个除了做的菜以外，本人也一样温暖的厨师，注意到那羞涩腼腆的笑容，注意到那个虽然不是令人惊艳，却越看越有味道的小女人。
原本告诉自己她跟他太不一样了，他知道自己的外表一向只会吓跑那种类型的女性，本想就这样常常去吃饭，看看她就满足了，直到那天她怯生生的站在他面前，快哭出来似的对他说——她喜欢他……
从十几岁离家到现在，他拥有的一切全是靠自己的双手一点一点打拼累积起来的，他不知道什么叫做从天而降的好运。
不过现在他知道了。
眼前这个跟在店里不太一样，迷迷糊糊却又孩子气的小女人，让他不由得升起一种想要保护她、想要给她所有的冲动。
一根蟹脚哪有什么，只要她想要，再多他也可以给，只要让那幸福的笑容一直出现在她娇憨的小脸上。
如果仔细看的话会发现褚天阔那总是严肃的黝黑脸庞，线条微微的软化了，眼中似乎还带着笑意。只是乔若曦根本就不敢对上他的眼，更遑论注意到他难得温柔的表情。
“谢谢你。”不知道该怎么跟眼前这个男人相处，更搞不懂他脑子里在想什么，所以她只好尴尬的把手收回，放回自己碗里。

安静的包厢里，两人各自动着筷子，却不知道要跟对方说些什么才恰当。
用完餐，乔若曦觉得自己似乎该说些什么，“呃……谢谢你，带我来这么好的地方，还享用了这么美味的食物。”
褚天阔没有回话，只是酷酷的点点头。
又是一段难熬的沉默。
“呵……这地方不错呢！”她只得继续找话题聊。
闻言，他的脸僵硬了片刻，然后清咳一声。“第一次约会，我想给你最好的。”
她说不出话，心脏停了一秒，然后又剧烈的跳动起来。
意料之外的答案让她措手不及，看他的外表，她根本没办法想像他是会考虑到这种事的人。想到自己赴约之前，还一直把事情往最坏的方向想，而在此同时，他却是用第一次约会的慎重心情规划这一切……
content_en:
She took over all the work in the store by herself, tried her best to make money to support herself, and collected money every month to repay her creditors.
Seriously, it's very tiring. She had never dared to think too much and had always tried her best to do everything well. Now when she relaxed, the fatigue overwhelmed her instantly.
The hot water made her a little dizzy. She half-opened her eyes and saw a leaf falling on the water. She found it interesting and stretched out her hand to catch it, but she didn't know whether she was dizzy or her feet slipped. She stood up and reached out, but not only did she not catch the leaf, but she also lost her balance——
"Ah -" she screamed and fell into the water in a panic. The hot water poured into her mouth and nose, choking her and making it impossible to breathe.
She struggled out of the water, feeling sharp pain in her knees.
She was about to look down at the injury on her knee when suddenly there was a bang and she heard the door being knocked open, and the next second, a tall figure appeared in front of her.
"What's wrong?" He looked worried.
Qiao Ruoxi's hair was wet, her face was covered with hot spring water and tears, and her knees were in terrible pain. But when she saw Chu Tiankuo, her mouth opened wide and she couldn't say a word. She even forgot about the pain. She could only hold her chest with her hands and scream at the top of her voice.
Chapter 2(1)
The woman wrapped in a bathrobe and a pile of towels had swollen eyes and a red nose. She looked extremely pitiful, like a wet kitten. Her slightly trembling body made people want to hold her in their arms.
Chu Tiankuo approached her and saw her trembling violently. The big eyes that looked at him were filled with warning and a little accusation and fear, which made him sink his face.
"Where's the injury? Let me see."
Qiao Ruoxi shook her head desperately.
Still watching? Every part of her body was exposed to him! Wow...so embarrassing.
"Let me see." His voice was lowered, and his downcast face held a majesty that could not be denied.
She bit her lower lip, but in the end she was still timid
His expression turned even uglier. He grabbed her legs with his thick palms. She wanted to pull back out of shame and fear, but those giant pincer-like hands prevented her from moving even half an inch.
"Don't move!"
She can't move either!
There was a medical kit brought by the hotel proprietress to the side. He took out iodine and cotton swabs from it, "It will hurt a little." His voice became softer.
He is not someone who has never seen various wounds. In fact, in the early years, he still lived a life of fighting and fighting every day, but such ugly wounds should not appear on this fair, soft and flawless skin.
The wound seemed to be an eyesore and made him uncomfortable. A feeling similar to pain spread faintly in his chest.
He focused on treating her wounds, and although his big hands seemed rough, they were unexpectedly gentle. Moreover, he was not as rude to her as she feared, although the way he glared at her wounds was still so fierce that her heart was pounding.
"Thank you..."
He raised his head and glared at her. There was anger in that glare, but also a vague feeling of distress.
"Uh...I'm sorry..." Actually, she didn't know why she said sorry, but seeing his expression, she felt that she should say so.
"Be careful in the future." He gritted his teeth. He didn't want to see her hurt anymore. No one could hurt her, not even herself.
Qiao Ruoxi had a strange feeling, as if it was not her who was hurt, but like she had broken something of his. She subconsciously shrank her shoulders.
Although she knew that with her confused and inflexible hands and feet, it was really impossible not to stumble, but at this time she could only say obediently: "Yes."
He frowned, as if deciding whether to "forgive" her or not. Her heart hung in the air for a long time before she saw him sigh.
She was still stunned when the warm palm touched her face, not knowing how to react. The feeling he gave her had nothing to do with gentleness, but tonight he surprised her again and again.
Just when she was confusedAt that moment, a knock on the door broke the ambiguous atmosphere in the room.
"I'm sorry." The landlady opened the paper door, "Is the lady's injury okay?"
"Yes." Chu Tiankuo answered on her behalf.
"Really? Then I'll be relieved. I'm really sorry. It was our facilities that caused the lady's injury, and the store must bear the liability for compensation."
"No, no! No! I was too careless." Qiao Ruoxi quickly clarified.
"You are so polite, Miss, but let us express our apologies! Can we let our restaurant serve you dinner? You two must be hungry after all this trouble. Is it convenient to serve the food now?"
Speaking of dinner, Qiao Ruoxi's stomach actually made a growling sound at this time.
The whole day of worry and fear prevented her from eating much at all, but she couldn't do it at this time...
Her face turned red with a bang, and the landlady lowered her head to hide her smile. Chu Tiankuo didn't say anything, but she felt like she wanted to die.
"Dinner will be served to you soon." The landlady hurriedly went down to prepare.
Not long after, when the hot king crab hot pot was served, Qiao Ruoxi was so happy that she had long forgotten the embarrassment she had just experienced.
"Taste it."
Following the boss's instructions, she put the crab legs into her mouth. The sweet and fresh taste spread immediately, which made her almost cry.
"So...oooo...so delicious!"
Qiao Ruoxi is a person who loves food, otherwise she would not be a good chef. Just because she opened a store and wanted to save money, she had not eaten out for several years, so she felt extremely happy at the moment, so happy that she almost forgot about her situation.
Until there was a piece of hot crab leg in her bowl, she suddenly looked up and found that the proprietress had left, and the person who put the food into her bowl could only be one person.
"Ah, just eat it." She wanted to put the crab legs back into his bowl, but he grabbed her hand.
"Here you go."
He liked to watch her eating and the way she enjoyed it with her eyes closed.
But to him, the most delicious food was the food she cooked. Although her cuisine was not as gorgeous and exquisite as the big restaurant, it gave people a warm feeling.
Although the decoration of her coffee shop is a bit childish, he fell in love with the taste after going there once after a friend recommended it.
Over time, he noticed the chef who was also warm in person besides the food he cooked, noticed the shy smile, and noticed the little woman who, although not stunning, was becoming more and more interesting as he looked at her.
He originally told himself that she was so different from him. He knew that his appearance would only scare away that type of women. He wanted to go out to eat often and be satisfied just by looking at her. Until that day, she stood timidly in front of him and told him as if she was about to cry - she likes him...
From leaving home when he was a teenager to now, everything he has has been accumulated bit by bit with his own hands. He doesn't know what good luck falling from the sky means.
But now he knows.
The little woman in front of him was different from the one in the store. She was confused but childish, and he couldn't help but feel the urge to protect her and give her everything.
A crab leg is nothing. As long as she wants it, he can give it no matter how much, as long as that happy smile always appears on her cute little face.
If you look carefully, you will find that the lines on Chu Tiankuo's always serious dark face have softened slightly, and there seems to be a smile in his eyes. But Qiao Ruoxi didn't dare to meet his eyes at all, let alone notice his rare gentle expression.
"Thank you." She didn't know how to get along with the man in front of her, and she couldn't figure out what was going on in his mind, so she had to withdraw her hand in embarrassment and put it back into her bowl.
In the quiet private room, the two of them were holding their chopsticks, but they didn't know what to say to each other.
After finishing the meal, Qiao Ruoxi felt that she shouldSay something like, "Uh...thank you for taking me to such a nice place and enjoying such delicious food."
Chu Tiankuo didn't reply, just nodded coolly.
There was another uncomfortable silence.
"Ha... this place is nice!" She could only continue to find topics to talk about.
Hearing this, his face stiffened for a moment, and then he coughed. "On our first date, I want to give you the best."
She was speechless, her heart stopped for a second, and then started beating violently again.
The unexpected answer caught her off guard. Judging from his appearance, she couldn't imagine that he would consider such a thing. Thinking that before he went on the date, he had been thinking about the worst, but at the same time, he was planning it all with the caution of a first date...
